title: Jensen gaps and the decomposition principle
abstract: arXiv:2610.33786v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We provide axiomatic characterizations of Jensen-gap functionals, which have the form $\rho(X)=\mathbb{E}[f(X)]-f(\mathbb{E}[X])$ for some real-valued function $f$ called the generator. This class includes important examples such as the excess growth rate, the utility premium, the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence, and the variance, and is also closely related to measures of variability. We analyze various forms of convexity for Jensen gaps. To characterize Jensen gaps, we formulate conditional versions of law-invariant functionals, which are needed to state the decomposition principle. On an atomless probability space, we show that law invariance together with a binary decomposition principle is sufficient to characterize Jensen gaps on simple random variables. translated_abstract: 我们为詹森差距泛函提供了公理化刻画，这类泛函的形式为 $\rho(X)=\mathbb{E}[f(X)]-f(\mathbb{E}[X])$，其中 $f$ 是某个实值函数，称为生成函数。该类泛函包含许多重要例子，如超额增长率、效用溢价、Kullback-Leibler（KL）散度和方差，并且与变异性度量密切相关。我们分析了詹森差距的多种凸性形式。为了刻画詹森差距，我们提出了律不变泛函的条件版本，这是陈述分解原理所必需的。在无原子概率空间上，我们证明律不变性结合二元分解原理足以刻画简单随机变量上的詹森差距。在适当的连续性条件下，该刻画可扩展到更广泛的类别，包括具有紧支撑的随机变量和可积随机变量。
tldr: 本文通过公理化方法刻画了詹森差距泛函这一统一框架（涵盖超额增长率、效用溢价、KL散度和方差等重要例子），并证明律不变性与二元分解原理相结合足以在无原子概率空间上唯一确定这类泛函。
